newsitem.title: USA: Sun Microsystems Inc unveils JavaStation.
newsitem.headline: Sun Microsystems Inc unveils JavaStation.

text.p: Sun Microsystems Inc said it introduced its first network computer called the JavaStation, a scaled-down personal computer to access corporate networks and the Internet, with an entry level price of $742.

The company said the entry level model will contain eight megabytes of memory and it will ship beginning in December. A fully-configured system, which includes memory, a keyboard, a mouse and fourteen-inch monitor will ship for $995.
Sun also said it will ship a JavaStation with 16 megabytes of memory for $1565.
